gitlabMethodRebaseMerge: merge commit with a rebased branch
squashForcedOn: The project always squashes the commits.
squashForcedOff: The project never squashes the commits.
deleteBranch: Delete the source branch {branch} after the merge
deleteBranchPermanent: {branch} is a permanent branch: it is never deleted.
deleteBranchByRepository: The repository deletes the source branch after each merge (setting of GitHub "Automatically delete head branches").
shaHint: Merges the last commit seen ({sha}): if someone pushed since, {forge} refuses the merge.
cancelTitle: Close the window and merge nothing
mergeTitle: Merge with the choices of the window
buttonTitle: Open the merge window: choose the method and the deletion of the branch, then confirm
blockNotOpen: It is not open any more.
blockDraft: It is a draft: mark it as ready first.
blockConflict: It is in conflict with the target branch.
blockBehind: The branch must be updated with the target branch first.
blockRule: A rule of the target branch blocks it, for example a required check.
blockChecksRunning: A required check is still running.
blockOther: The hosting service refuses the merge now ({status}).
blockDeletedByRepository: The repository deletes the source branch after each merge, and {branch} is a permanent branch: merge it on the web page.
